results.name: A Complete Podcast Studio
results.description:
Free, ready-to-use podcast studio — film, shoot, or create your next project with ease!

This compact studio is perfect for podcast filming, indoor action scenes, pre-wedding shoots, wedding stages, parties, and press conferences. It includes a professional green screen for versatile video content and chroma key effects.

Free for personal and commercial use in games, videos, or films — just don’t resell or redistribute it.

All parts are modular, detailed, and easy to edit with non–baked textures. Fully game-ready, requiring no major adjustments — simply set it up and add your own props like tables, microphones, or lights.

The hall features two rooms, with one left empty for your own creative setup.

Bring your ideas to life. Download now, and if you like this model, please leave a like and follow for more free, high-quality 3D assets and studio environments.

results.name: Soviet Panelki — Voxel Style Apartment Buildings

results.name: Thymio robot
results.description:
*Wikipedia description* 
> Thymio II is an educational robot in the 100 Euros price range. The robot was developed at the EPFL in collaboration with ECAL, both in Lausanne, Switzerland. A purely-visual programming language was developed at ETH Zurich .[1] All components, both hardware and software, are open source. The main features of the robot are a large number of sensors and actuators, educational interactivity based on light and touch, and a programming environment featuring graphical and text programming. Thymio has over 20 sensors and 40 lights and integrates with third party languages such as MIT's Scratch.

results.name: Evil Halloween Pumpkin Jack-o'-Lantern
results.description:
Bring Halloween to life with this spooky Jack-o'-Lantern pumpkin! 🎃
This 3D printable model is hollow inside, so you can place an LED light, fairy lights, or even a small candle to create a terrifying glow from its eyes, nose, and sharp-toothed grin.

Perfect as a Halloween decoration for your home, party, or garden. The design includes:

Evil pumpkin face with sharp teeth 😈

Hollow interior for safe lighting

Printable in one piece
"works great with LED tea lights (safe alternative to candles)"

You can scale it up or down to fit your Halloween setup. Whether for a table centerpiece, porch light, or spooky décor, this pumpkin will surely impress trick-or-treaters and guests!
